name: fast
title: Fast lane - code, verify, ship with no gates
titleAr: المسار السريع — كود ← تحقق ← رفع بدون وقفات
description: Skips planning. A fast agentic coder implements straight from the task text, checks run automatically, and a cheap fast model reviews. Use it for small, well-understood changes.

stages.title: Implementation
stages.prompt:
Task: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Repository context is in .workbench/artifacts/context.md. There is no plan file for this flow - implement the task directly, following the conventions you see in the touched files. Keep the change minimal and focused. Write code-notes.md per your role contract.
done: The task is implemented or the blocker is stated explicitly in code-notes.md
code-notes.md lists changed files and how-to-verify commands

stages.title: Verify
stages.prompt: Verify the change in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Focus on: does it build, do the checks pass, does the change do what {TASK} asked. Write review.md and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
The checks result (PASS / FAIL / SKIPPED) is quoted in review.md

stages.title: Debug & root-cause
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL. Fix the failures per .workbench/artifacts/review.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Reproduce first, fix root causes only. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is addressed or refuted with evidence
All previously failing commands now pass (shown in debug.md)

stages.title: Ship & deliver
stages.prompt: The change PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. Write ship.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Fast lane finished - commit the change?
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
